pages.text: “As the poppies bloom, a gentle breeze passes by—delicate yet resilient.”$(br2)Poppy Tea is a brightly colored and uniquely flavored beverage made from dried poppy petals. With its smooth taste and a hint of sweetness, drinking it grants travelers short-term health regeneration, soothing the body and revitalizing energy.

$(br2)$(br)Poppy Tea is simple to prepare—$(br)blend dried poppy petals with sugar to create this warm and revitalizing tea.$(br)It is best consumed during travels, allowing for quick recovery during moments of rest.

Upon drinking Poppy Tea, travelers gain temporary health regeneration, gradually restoring vitality.$(br)This tea is a warm and gentle beverage, perfect for relieving fatigue on long journeys.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
